title: Integration: SLAM 450, Intention, resources and storage
summary: SLAM 450 should use a persistent Building object for Blues Point Tower, with typed, verified architectural height and geometry, rather than owning a separate world fact. Do not treat the illustrative 72 m as verified. IntentionService v0.1-dev11 owns recognition/confirmation/dispatch. Location providers supply specific geography and should not replicate that framework.
invariants: Register JURISDICTIONS_AT, JURISDICTIONS_ALONG, WHAT_IS_AT, HEIGHT, NEAREST, VISIBLE_FROM, LINE_OF_SIGHT and STREETS_ALONG through IntentionService's actual registration contract when integrated.
Use capability-identified providers, no hard-coded sources or ad hoc coordinate conversions.
Spatial data must use explicit CRS/datum/vertical datum and declared transform providers, fail closed when missing.
Layer high-resolution partial site coverage over coarse country coverage with bounded Storage Fabric reads; site DEM and mesh are lazy-loaded.
Use RexxOS two MI per job (rto2) when execution is promoted to operational service.

NoSQLServer v0.92-dev1 has native rowid seek but writable snapshot-per-statement cost; Rexx/SQL indexed benchmark is separate and may be faster. Backend must be evidence-selected and capability-injected.
Do not import F11, Power SLAM, Wire3D or existing SLAM classes into a duplicate source tree; adapt their published interfaces.

provenance.claim: NoSQLServer and Rexx/SQL performance and limits
